title: HD Hyundai Robotics partners with Palantir on AI solutions
caption:
HD Hyundai Robotics is teaming up with Palantir to develop physical AI systems for heavy industrial environments. The collaboration focuses on autonomous manufacturing while keeping proprietary plant data protected.

Source: Koreaherald - HD Hyundai Robotics partners with Palantir on AI solutions
